svg.title: Deployment view — workload boundaries
svg.desc: Recorded private lab: one CPU control/data VM and one GPU worker. Boxes identify individual workload resources.
svg.text: Recorded private lab: one CPU control/data VM and one GPU worker. Boxes identify individual workload resources.
Architecture illustration — not a runtime screenshot. Source: docs/diagrams/platform.py
GOOGLE CLOUD VM — 8 vCPU / 64 GiB RAM
Docker — independent containers and on-demand jobs
Supporting databases, DAG processors and secondary UI services are omitted; consult the linked runtime manifests.
Weights and state stay on the VM.
Use the runbook for live readiness.
Warm workers share the CPU VM.
U: IAP access to a loopback viewer; the VM viewer verifies gateway HTTPS. G: private model request/response.
Data, training and telemetry handoffs have separate workflow views. This recorded topology does not establish live readiness or host-level failover.
